rule: Targets follow the seats: the dealer owes 8, the seat to their left 5, the next 3 -- and 8+5+3 = 16 matches the trick count exactly. Nobody bids. Every trick past your target scores, and every one short is paid for next round in your best cards.
trumpUndecided: Trump: undeclared (the dealer chooses, and takes the {{kitty}}-card kitty)

promptDiscardWait: The dealer is sorting the kitty.
